full_judgment:
4. The relevant facts as stated in the writ petition are that the writ petitioner-respondent was a service holder of Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Corporation (BIWTC) and the writ-respondents are government officials and public functionaries. The petitioner joined in the service of BIWTC on 22-11-1989 as a class-1 officer. He was given an additional charge of Deputy Chief Purchase Officer from 8-4-1983. Due to his efficiency, sincerity and devotion to his duty, he was promoted to the post of Deputy Chief Purchase Officer on 26-9-1996. Thereafter, he was transferred and posted as Deputy Secretary (Administration). Due to his efficiency, the authority again gave him additional charge of Secretary from 2000 and then promoted to the said post of Secretary on 29-11-2000 and subsequently, the said date of promotion was re-fixed on 28-9-2001 as duration of his service in the feeder post was not completed five years as per the requirement of the বাংলাদেশ অভ্যন্তরীণ নৌ পরিবহন কর্পোরেশন কর্মচারী চাকুরী প্রবিধানমালা, ১৯৮৯ (shortly, কর্মচারী চাকুরী প্রবিধানমালা, ১৯৮৯) and his salary was re-fixed in the scale of Secretary the higher scale. 

 8. The Ministry of Public Administration vide its circular No. সম/উনি-৩/২(২)-২/৮৮-১৩৫ তারিখ ১-৪-৯০ stated that in the matter of appointment of the member Director of the Board of Directors of the Autonomous Body /Corporate, preference should be given to the competent officers working in those Autonomous Bodies/Corporations and without considering such officers, no other officer should be proposed for appointment at all in those posts on deputation. By the circular dated 28-8-1988, government prescribed the qualification for the officers of different posts of Autonomous Bodies like whole time Chief, Member of Board of Directors/Directors of the Autonomous Body and as per circular the petitioner has the requisite experience, criteria and qualification. 

 12. The writ-respondent No.3 filed an affidavit-in-opposition stating, inter alia, that the petitioner joined the BIWTC as an officer on 22-11-1989 in accordance with office order bearing memo No.AF.-4,12Amr I Thereafter, in accordance with the office order bearing memo No. কঃবিঃ-৯৫/৯৩ dated 8-4-1993, the petitioner was given the additional charge of Deputy Chief Purchase Manager. Subsequently; vide office order bearing memo No. কঃবিঃ-৩০১/৯৬ dated 26-9-1996 the petitioner was promoted to the post of Deputy Chief Purchase Manager, Purchase Department. Thereafter, vide office order bearing memo No. বি.এ.-০১/২০০০ dated 20-2-2000, the petitioner was transferred to the Secretariat Department and given the post of Deputy Secretary (Administration). Following a vacancy opening up for the post of Secretary, the petitioner was promoted to the said post of Secretary vide office order bearing memo No.কঃবিঃ-৩১৭/২০০০ dated 29-11-2000. 

 21. We have gone through the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in Writ Petition No.5001 of 2013 and the materials on record. The petitioner claimed that the writ petitioner-respondent joined the BIWTC as an officer on 22-11-1988. Thereafter, in accordance with office order, the petitioner was given the additional charge of Deputy Chief Purchase Manager. Subsequently, vide office order bearing memo No. কঃবিঃ-৩০১/৯৬ dated 26-9-1996 the petitioner was promoted to the post of Deputy Chief Purchase Manager, Purchase Department. Thereafter, vide office order bearing memo No. বি.এ.-০১/২০০০ dated 20-2-2000, the petitioner was transferred to the Secretariat Department and given the post of Deputy Secretary (Administration). Following a vacancy opening up for the post of Secretary, the petitioner was promoted to the said post of Secretary vide office order bearing memo No. কঃবিঃ-৩১৭/২০০০ dated 29-11-2000. 

 23. The writ-petitioner-respondent claimed that due to his efficiency, sincerity and devotion to his duty, he was promoted to the post of Deputy Chief Purchase Officer on 26-9-1996. Thereafter, he was transferred and posted as Deputy Secretary (Administration). Due to his efficiency, the authority again gave him additional charge of Secretary from 2000 and then promoted to the said post of Secretary on 29-11-2000 and subsequently, the authority corrected the date of promotion to the post of Secretary on 28-9-2001 since inadvertently his service in the feeder post was not five years as per the requirement of the বাংলাদেশ অভ্যন্তরীণ নৌ পরিবহন কর্পোরেশনে কর্মচারী চাকুরী প্রবিধানমালা, ১৯৮৯ and his salary was re-fixed as Secretary in the higher scale.
